create_get_logger: create a logger with a specified name for the evaluate library
test_set_verbosity: test setting the evaluate library root logger to a custom verbosity level
review_get_verbosity: review the evaluate library root logger current effective logging level
summarize_tqdm: summarize the tqdm progress bar wrapper that conditionally enables or disables progress bars
build_disable_logging: build a call to disable log propagation for the evaluate library root logger
